reason: Replace authoring or engineering phrasing with the economic meaning
before:
The proposed product owns repeated semantic work: availability-aware
histories, target-preserving conversions, graph/identification traces,
inference contracts, policy information and reconstruction of evidence.
It reuses external numerical methods where their qualified contracts fit.
A host application still supplies product-specific behavior, its economic
account and decision constraints. This division creates possible reuse
without assuming that a mortgage equilibrium, an individual collections
policy and a macro shock all have one estimand.
after:
The proposed service would help analysts reconstruct what was known when
a decision was made, keep the population and outcome consistent, document
why an effect is identified, and carry uncertainty into the financial
comparison. It would reuse existing numerical methods where their
assumptions fit. Each business would still specify its products, costs and
constraints. A mortgage policy, an individual collections decision and a
macroeconomic shock need not share the same economic quantity of interest.

reason: Replace authoring or engineering phrasing with the economic meaning
before:
The immediate deliverable is a product proposal: a defensible account of
the decisions a shared causal library could improve, the methods and
software worth assembling, a bounded prototype, and the experiments
worth funding next. A bank deployment, accepted integration and measured
commercial return are later milestones. Requiring private assignment
logs, independent bank audits and production owners before completing
this proposal reverses the investment sequence. Those expensive inputs
should be requested only when less expensive evidence has established
both technical promise and a consequential uncertainty that they can
resolve.
after:
A bank should invest in a causal-analysis service only when there is a
credible account of the decisions it could improve, the methods worth
assembling and the experiments worth funding. Public evidence can establish
technical promise and identify consequential uncertainties before a bank
pays to collect private assignment histories or commission a larger trial.
The proposed studies follow that investment sequence.

reason: Remove internal manuscript obligations; retain scientific scope
before:
The three major manuscript repairs remain obligations: systematic
software coverage and reuse/commercial comparisons; the developed
treatment of language models and agents; and CLI, MCP, library and
workspace integration. The public-data survey supplies their evaluation
substrate. It does not finish those chapters or automatically close any
scientific gap. The software and language-model page/depth commitments
also remain; pages in this public-data section are not counted twice
toward them.
after:
Public evidence informs three choices: which existing methods to reuse,
where language assistance is useful, and how analysts should conduct a
reproducible study. A dataset can reveal a timing error or support a
controlled comparison without settling every question about those choices.

reason: Replace authoring or engineering phrasing with the economic meaning
before:
Proposal acceptance means the scholarly argument is coherent,
source-grounded and sufficiently complete; the software and agent
landscape has been compared seriously; the integration design is
concrete; the public/synthetic demonstrations are reproducible within
their claims; and the next investment decision follows from an explicit
comparison and cost model. Open research can be retained with a scoped
conjecture, failure result and next test. A general theorem is not
promised where only a restricted construction is known.
after:
The investment decision requires a comparison of feasible alternatives,
their costs and the evidence for their expected benefits. Reproducible
public and simulated studies can support that comparison within their
stated assumptions. A restricted result may justify a narrow prototype
while leaving broader research questions unresolved.

before:
The proposal therefore replaces a premature demand for authentic bank
qualification with a public-evidence portfolio. It does not replace an
unknown bank effect with the effect from another population. The claim
being evaluated changes from ``this system improves this bank's
decisions'' to ``these capabilities are technically credible,
reproducible and sufficiently promising to justify this specific next
experiment.'' A negative comparison, a useful refusal, or a narrowed
capability can be a successful research deliverable when it changes that
investment decision honestly.
